claim: A source-identified BCHN v29.0.0 no-wallet build started two isolated local Chipnet processes and exposed their genesis-only RPC state; it did not produce a live peer, independent-operator, or transaction-behavior result.
commands: git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; git status --short; git fsck --no-dangling
bitcoind -chipnet <isolated loopback-only arguments>; bitcoin-cli getnetworkinfo|getblockchaininfo|getmempoolinfo|getpeerinfo|getconnectioncount; bitcoin-cli stop

tests.name: pinned BCHN v29 source build
tests.expected: tag resolves to recorded commit and no-wallet binaries build

tests.name: isolated Chipnet RPC startup
tests.expected: two separately configured local daemons expose runtime state and stop cleanly
tests.observed: two genesis-only local daemons returned network, chain, and mempool RPC responses and stopped

tests.name: loopback peer handshake
tests.observed: no completed handshake; daemon logged connection dropped full

tests.name: two independent BCHN v29 peer reproductions

limitations: The runtime was locally initialized at Chipnet genesis, not synchronized to current Chipnet.
Both processes ran on one host and are not independent operators.
The sole loopback peer configuration did not complete a P2P handshake.
No wallet, funds, private key, transaction construction, testmempoolaccept, submission, relay, broadcast, mining, or mainnet activity occurred.
This record cannot contribute a G1 pass claim.
